text: June, eighteen twelve. Napoleon crosses the river Niemen, into Russia.
sub: June 1812. Napoleon crosses the River Niemen, into Russia.
asr: June 1812, Napoleon crosses the river Niemen into Russia.

text: By one famous count, he has four hundred and twenty-two thousand men.
sub: By one famous count, he has 422,000 men.
asr: By one famous count, he has 422,000 men.

text: The Russians fall back, and burn what they leave behind.
sub: The Russians fall back, and burn what they leave behind.

text: Napoleon follows them east. Vee-tebsk. Smolensk. Borodino.
sub: Napoleon follows them east. Vitebsk. Smolensk. Borodino.
asr: Napoleon follows them east. Vitebsk, Smolensk, Borodino.

text: Heat, sickness, desertion and battle cost him men at every step.
sub: Heat, sickness, desertion and battle cost him men at every step.

text: In September he reaches Moscow, with about a hundred thousand left.
sub: In September he reaches Moscow, with about 100,000 left.
asr: In September he reaches Moscow with about 100,000 left.

text: The city burns. The Tsar refuses to talk peace.
sub: The city burns. The Tsar refuses to talk peace.

text: In October, the army turns back. Then winter comes.
sub: In October, the army turns back. Then winter comes.

text: Snow, hunger and Cossacks, all the way to the river.
sub: Snow, hunger and Cossacks, all the way to the river.
asr: Snow, hunger and Cossacks all the way to the river.

text: About ten thousand make it back across the Niemen.
sub: About 10,000 make it back across the Niemen.
asr: About 10,000 make it back across the Niemen.

text: Out of four hundred and twenty-two thousand.
asr: Out of four hundred and twenty-two thousand.
